anxious.title: Refuge from worry and grief
anxious.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ، وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
anxious.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal.
anxious.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from helplessness and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from the weight of debt and from being overpowered by others.

anxious.title: Hasbiyallah
anxious.transliteration: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa Huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu, wa Huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Azim.
anxious.meaning: Allah is enough for me. There is no god but Him. In Him I put my trust, and He is Lord of the Mighty Throne.
anxious.arabic: حَسْبِىَ ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ ۖ وَهُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

anxious.title: The dua of distress
anxious.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
anxious.transliteration: La ilaha illallahul-'Azimul-Halim. La ilaha illallahu Rabbul-'Arshil-'Azim. La ilaha illallahu Rabbus-samawati wa Rabbul-ardi wa Rabbul-'Arshil-Karim.
anxious.meaning: There is no god but Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.

anxious.title: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum
anxious.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
anxious.transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum, bi rahmatika astaghith.
anxious.meaning: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all, by Your mercy I call for help.

sad.meaning: There is no god but You. Glory be to You. Truly, I have been among those who wronged themselves.

lonely.meaning: Glory be to Allah, and all praise is His.

overwhelmed.meaning: There is no god but Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.

overwhelmed.title: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal-wakil

overwhelmed.transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
overwhelmed.meaning: There is no power and no strength except through Allah.

overwhelmed.transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum, bi rahmatika astaghith.
overwhelmed.meaning: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all, by Your mercy I call for help.

tired.title: The tasbih of Fatimah
tired.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
tired.meaning: Glory be to Allah. All praise is for Allah. Allah is the Greatest. Given to Fatimah when she was worn out, as something better than a servant.

tired.title: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum
tired.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
tired.transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum, bi rahmatika astaghith.
tired.meaning: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all, by Your mercy I call for help.

tired.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
tired.transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
tired.meaning: There is no power and no strength except through Allah.

behind-on-studies.title: Rabbi zidni 'ilma
behind-on-studies.meaning: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

behind-on-studies.title: Beneficial knowledge
behind-on-studies.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي، وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي، وَزِدْنِي عِلْمًا
behind-on-studies.transliteration: Allahumman-fa'ni bima 'allamtani, wa 'allimni ma yanfa'uni, wa zidni 'ilma.
behind-on-studies.meaning: O Allah, benefit me through what You have taught me, teach me what will benefit me, and increase me in knowledge.

behind-on-studies.title: Refuge from worry and grief
behind-on-studies.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ، وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ

behind-on-studies.transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
behind-on-studies.meaning: There is no power and no strength except through Allah.

unmotivated.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal.
unmotivated.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from helplessness and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from the weight of debt and from being overpowered by others.

unmotivated.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
unmotivated.transliteration: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibadatik.
unmotivated.meaning: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You well.

unmotivated.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
unmotivated.transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
unmotivated.meaning: There is no power and no strength except through Allah.

angry.title: Seeking refuge when angry
angry.meaning: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the rejected. The Prophet ﷺ said this would take away the anger of a man who was furious.

angry.title: The dua of distress
angry.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ

angry.meaning: There is no god but Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.

angry.title: Seeking forgiveness
angry.meaning: I ask Allah for forgiveness and I turn back to Him.
angry.repeatNote: the Prophet ﷺ said it more than seventy times a day

guilty.title: Sayyid al-Istighfar
guilty.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
guilty.transliteration: Allahumma Anta Rabbi, la ilaha illa Anta, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduka, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata'tu, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu, abu'u laka bi ni'matika 'alayya, wa abu'u laka bi dhanbi, faghfir li, fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa Anta.
guilty.meaning: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant. I keep to Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the harm of what I have done. I admit Your favour upon me, and I admit my sin, so forgive me, for no one forgives sins except You.

guilty.title: The dua of Yunus
guilty.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta, subhanaka, inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.
guilty.meaning: There is no god but You. Glory be to You. Truly, I have been among those who wronged themselves.
guilty.source: Qur'an 21:87; its virtue is in Jami' at-Tirmidhi 3505
guilty.arabic: لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

guilty.title: Seeking forgiveness
guilty.meaning: I ask Allah for forgiveness and I turn back to Him.
guilty.repeatNote: the Prophet ﷺ said it more than seventy times a day

afraid.meaning: Allah is enough for us, and He is the best one to rely on.

afraid.title: Hasbiyallah

afraid.title: Protection morning and evening
afraid.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ، وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
afraid.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'as-mihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama', wa Huwas-Sami'ul-'Alim.
afraid.meaning: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the heavens can cause harm. He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

grateful.title: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika
grateful.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
grateful.transliteration: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibadatik.
grateful.meaning: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You well.

grateful.title: When something pleases you
grateful.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
grateful.meaning: All praise is for Allah, by whose favour good things are made complete.

grateful.title: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi
grateful.meaning: Glory be to Allah, and all praise is His.

happy.title: When something pleases you
happy.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
happy.meaning: All praise is for Allah, by whose favour good things are made complete.

happy.title: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi
happy.meaning: Glory be to Allah, and all praise is His.

happy.title: Rabbana atina
happy.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar.
happy.meaning: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
happy.source: Sahih al-Bukhari 6389; Sahih Muslim 2690 (words from Qur'an 2:201)
happy.arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ

hopeful.title: Rabbana atina
hopeful.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar.
hopeful.meaning: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
